videos.video_subject: Messi was reported to be presenting the 2026 Ballon d'Or; Fabrizio Romano said he was not invited to present; Messi, 39, is on the 30-man shortlist after the World Cup final
videos.video_script: Messi was rumoured to hand out the Ballon d'Or. A Spanish reporter claimed he would give the trophy to the winner on stage, and fans read it as a sign for Yamal. Then Fabrizio Romano shut it down. Messi, he said, has not even been invited to present. At thirty-nine, Messi is still on the shortlist after taking Argentina to the World Cup final. The ceremony is on the twenty-sixth of October. Did the Ballon d'Or just snub him?
